title: Zones
subtitle: Manage authoritative, forwarder, and catalog zones hosted on this server

list.emptyHint: Create your first zone, or import from a zone file.

Primary.label: Primary
Primary.hint: This server holds authoritative data; records can be freely edited.

Secondary.label: Secondary
Secondary.hint: Replicates data from a primary name server via zone transfer.

Stub.label: Stub
Stub.hint: Syncs only NS and glue records for delegation.

Forwarder.label: Forwarder
Forwarder.hint: Forwards queries under this domain to a designated resolver.

ConditionalForwarder.label: Conditional forwarder
ConditionalForwarder.hint: Forwarding rule that applies only to specific domains.

Catalog.label: Catalog
Catalog.hint: Bulk-manages member zones using RFC 9432 catalog zones.

SecondaryCatalog.label: Secondary catalog
SecondaryCatalog.hint: Replicates member configuration from an upstream catalog zone.

SecondaryForwarder.label: Secondary forwarder
SecondaryForwarder.hint: Forwarding configuration synchronized via zone transfer.

SecondaryRoot.label: Root hints
SecondaryRoot.hint: A Secondary zone seeded with the 13 root name server groups.

Reverse.label: Reverse
Reverse.hint: An in-addr.arpa or ip6.arpa zone used for PTR records.

create.title: Create zone
create.subtitle: Choose a zone type and fill in the required parameters
create.zoneHelp: For reverse zones, enter a subnet such as 192.168.1.0/24 or 2001:db8::/64.
create.typeHelp: Different types require different parameters; the form adjusts automatically.
create.catalogHelp: When selected, this zone's configuration is managed by the catalog zone.
create.useSoaSerialDateSchemeHelp: SOA serial uses yyyyMMddnn format for easier primary/secondary reconciliation.
create.primaryNameServersPlaceholder: One IP or hostname per line, e.g. 10.0.0.53
create.primaryNameServersHelp: Source addresses for zone transfer; multiple entries allowed.
create.tsigKeyHelp: Use a shared secret to authenticate zone transfers.
create.validateZoneHelp: Performs DNSSEC validation on received zone data; rejects on failure.
create.importFileHelp: Optional. Select a BIND-format zone file to import records after creation.
create.importFileDrop: Drop a zone file here, or click to browse
create.requiresForwarder: A forwarder zone requires a forwarder address
create.requiresNameServers: This zone type requires at least one primary name server address

import.title: Import zone file
import.subtitle: Merge a BIND-format zone file into an existing zone
import.overwriteHelp: Records with the same name and type will be replaced instead of causing an error.
import.overwriteZoneHelp: Removes all existing records in the zone before importing.
import.overwriteSoaSerialHelp: By default the local serial is auto-incremented.
import.previewHint: Parsed results are indicative; the server write is authoritative.
import.noFile: Select a zone file to upload

export.title: Export zone
export.downloadAllHint: Downloads every zone file sequentially; this may take a while.

actions.disableConfirm: A disabled zone will stop answering queries. Continue?
actions.resyncHint: Immediately re-pulls zone data from the primary name server.
actions.cloneHint: Copies all records from the source zone; SOA and NS are adjusted accordingly.
actions.convertHint: Only Primary, Forwarder, and Catalog zones can be converted between each other.
actions.convertWarning: Conversion changes the zone's data source; existing records may be lost. Export a backup first.
actions.deleteConfirm: Delete zone {zone}? All records within it will also be removed.
actions.deleteBulkConfirm: Delete the selected {count} zones? This cannot be undone.
actions.deleteProtected: This zone has delete protection enabled. Disable it in zone options first.

options.title: Zone options
options.subtitle: Configure query access, zone transfer, notify, and dynamic update policies for {zone}
options.deleteProtectionHelp: When enabled, all requests to delete this zone are rejected.
options.queryAccessNetworkACLHelp: Applies only when the policy is set to "Use specified network ACL"; one entry per line.
options.zoneTransferTsigHelp: Leave blank to allow any key name.
options.notifyNameServersHelp: Leave blank to use the NS records within the zone.
options.updateSecurityPoliciesHelp: Restrict TSIG keys and record types allowed for dynamic updates by domain.
options.overrideCatalogQueryAccess: Override catalog zone query access settings
options.overrideCatalogUpdate: Override catalog zone dynamic update settings
options.overrideCatalogUpdateSecurityPolicies: Override catalog zone update security policies
options.overrideHint: Unchecked items inherit the parent catalog zone's configuration.

notifyPolicies.BothThisServerAndSpecifiedNameServers: Notify both this server and specified name servers
notifyPolicies.SeparateNameServersForCatalogAndMemberZo: Use separate name servers for catalog and member zones

permissions.title: Zone permissions
permissions.subtitle: Control which users and groups can manage {zone}
permissions.empty: No permissions granted for this zone yet
permissions.emptyHint: Users without permissions cannot see this zone.
permissions.inheritHint: Zone permissions inherit from the "Zones" permission section; this provides fine-grained control.

detail.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted, or you lack permission to view it.
